paper_title: On the Role of Model Prior in Real-World Inductive Reasoning
caption: Human pairwise comparison results on three datasets, showing preferences for hypotheses with, without demos, and cases where it was hard to tell the difference.
model_annotation: This pie chart displays the results of human pairwise comparisons across three datasets, representing preferences for hypotheses regarding the inclusion of demonstrations. The chart contains five slices, labeled “Truthful Review,” “Funny Reddit,” “Unhealthy Comments,” “W/ Demos,” and “W/o Demos,” colored in shades of teal. The largest slice, “Truthful Review,” occupies approximately 43.0%, followed by “Unhealthy Comments” at roughly 37.8%. The slice labeled “W/o Demos” represents an estimated 34.8%, while “W/ Demos” is shown as approximately 22.9%, and “Funny Reddit” nearly 21.5%. Percentage labels are displayed within each individual slice, and there is no accompanying legend or visual emphasis applied to any of the segments. The slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest in terms of their angular size.
